premises.text: Healthcare needs a new software category—patient relationship management—as care models change
premises.evidence_span: demand for a new category of software we call patient relationship management

premises.text: Core insight: partnership between patient and provider makes care work best and cost least
premises.evidence_span: key insight for Avado's business is that healthcare works best and costs least when there's a partnership between the patient and the provider

premises.text: Care-plan trackers/notifications keep patients following plans they otherwise forget or misunderstand
premises.evidence_span: your health can go sideways when you're not following a care plan. And that frequently happens because the doctor tells you some things and you forget or you misunderstand

premises.text: System targets the 99% of life between office visits unlike visit-centric health IT
premises.evidence_span: current health IT systems are really geared around that office visit. And so that, in reality, is only 1% of your life or less. It's that other 99%

premises.text: Patient health dashboard aggregates trackers, messages, and provider-fed updates
premises.evidence_span: I think of this as your health dashboard. It's sort of the equivalent, if you think of what Mint did for your personal financial records, Avado does for your health records

premises.text: Connected health-record check-in streamlines the next appointment
premises.evidence_span: check-in service does, it's a rich message, and that will bring up, if it comes up with our cooperation, basically it brings up your connected health record

premises.text: Business model combines free viral features with premium and third-party services
premises.evidence_span: straightforward premium business model, the features that are free are ones that actually drive use and virality. And then the services is some of the magic in our business model

value.text: Patient-provider partnership that improves quality of life and lowers cost
value.evidence_span: healthcare partnership that we empower, you can live a longer life, higher quality, and actually pay less

causal_links.evidence_span: partnership between the patient and the provider
that other 99% that is so critical
